decisions.project: A reusable foundation agent skill: SKILL.md plus stdlib Python workflow/audit/validate scripts, references, and templates.
decisions.distribution: Local-only for now; no remote host, so CI and dependency-update services have no validation target yet.
decisions.must_not_change: Preserve the SKILL.md frontmatter/interface, the stateless scripts/workflow.py CLI, Python 3.9+ stdlib-only scripts, read-only audit.py and validate.py, and the assets/ templates.
decisions.runtime: Python 3.14 pinned with mise; the scripts keep their Python 3.9+ floor.
